notes.title: UNTITLED Update 1.2 | Donation Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce the UNTITLED 1.2 level update! This update adds new levels, new cubes, and a sandbox mode! 

• 25+ new levels
• 2 new cubes
• Sandbox mode
• Misc fixes to the base game
• All proceeds go to charity

All proceeds from UNTITLED will be donated to the "Act Blue Anti Racism and Police Brutality Funds" 

This donation will be split among several different charities combating racism in America.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ab_mn

Love,
Bean Boy Games

notes.title: UNTITLED Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce the UNTITLED 1.1 Quality of Life update! This update fixes a lot of little problems that have been mentioned through player feedback and overall makes the game feel a lot better. Here are a few things we have changed:

•	Hand animations. The hands antenna now will move as you pull the trigger. This leads to much more natural looking and feeling hands.
•	Various level readjustments. 
•	A better-looking fade for when the blocks get destroyed.
•	A fade-in for when the blocks spawn.
•	Various other small changes that make the overall experience better.
Hope you all have fun with the update and we hope to add more levels soon!

Love,
Bean Boy GamesːUNTITLEDAllColorsː

notes.title: UNTITLED - Hotfix 1.01
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Hope you are having fun with UNTITLED. We have received some feedback so we made some changes to the game. If you have any other suggestions, feel free to leave a comment in the discussion area. Thanks again!

- Changed most of the light blue box levels making them a little easier. People understood how to complete the level but where having trouble with the dexterity of it. This hopefully addresses that problem. 

- Changed how picking up boxes works. Now there is less delay when moving the box around. This should make throwing boxes feel more responsive. 

Love,
Bean Boy Games
